abilities.name: Swipe
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing physical damage.

abilities.name: Savage Blow/Savage Bleeding
abilities.description: The bear swipes its target with its front paws, dealing low physical damage twice, staggering (Savage Blow) and dealing minor direct bleed damage for 8 seconds (Savage Bleeding). This can be blocked to set the bear off-balance instead, though it won't negate the bleeding.

abilities.name: Crushing Swipe
abilities.description: The bear gets up on its hind legs and crashes down on its target, indicated by a red cone, dealing moderate physical damage and knocking down.

abilities.name: Ferocity
abilities.description: After the bear gets free from a crowd control, it roars loudly, granting itself a buff that unknown, no increase in damage

notes: According to the Bearclaw Mine loading screen, the Black Bears of High Rock are much larger than their brown or white cousins.

summary: Auridon, Bangkorai, Bleakrock Isle, Broken Helm Hollow, Fallen Grotto, Fallowstone Hall, The Frigid Grotto, Frostwater Tundra, Gavaudon, Giant's Run, Glenumbra, Glister Vale's Despair Realm, Menevia, Orkey's Hollow, Shattered Grove, Shinji's Scarp, Snapleg Cave, The Rift, Three Tribes Camp Bears are large, hostile creatures found across Tamriel. They will attack if you are infringing on their territory, and will always roar or growl in an effort to intimidate potential threats before attacking. Bear carcasses can sometimes be harvested for cloth scraps that can be refined for use in crafting. Bears in the wild can sometimes be seen scratching their backs against trees in the wilderness to mark their territory. A bear without nameplate is found in a cage at the Shimmerene docks.
